title: Text: DET Joe Vavra ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey it’s Anthony. I’m just wondering: How did Cron hit that ball, with that swing, over the fence? It looked like he threw his bat at it
Defensively, as if to foul it off

I didn’t get a chance to talk to him or replay it. Big strong man that takes a lot of pride in keeping everything fair. Most people would’ve popped up to shallow left. Amazing how he did what he did but also an amazing catch by Mr Greene!
Good, trying to get the veteran’s ready and keep teaching the young talent. Everyday is a blast that we can keep it going safely
Give me a call whenever you have a few minutes. Off the record, no quotes but I have some hitting observations I want to bounce off you. I don’t want to sound like an idiot when I write it
